transitions.semanticPurpose: Carry the work packet from the source board into the validation board without changing the visual contract.
transitions.stateChange: The packet changes from queued to validated while keeping its rectangular hard-edge geometry.
transitions.attentionHandoff: The packet starts on the outgoing row baseline and lands on the incoming row baseline.
transitions.styleContinuity: Square rectangles, 0-radius masks, zero-padding boxes, and grayscale hierarchy persist through the midpoint.
transitions.alignmentRule: Outgoing and incoming packets share a grid row baseline and orthogonal path.
transitions.edgeRule: All masks and panels remain square, rectangular, hard-edge, and 0-radius.
transitions.boxPaddingRule: All boxes keep internalPaddingPx 0; content remains flush to bounds with external gutters only.
transitions.grayscaleHierarchyRule: Outgoing, bridge, and incoming hierarchy use #333333, #696969, and #9c9c9c; hue only marks semantic state.
transitions.genericMotionRejected: A generic slide would move the packet but would not preserve the zero-padding box contract or show validation state change.
transitions.surprise: The packet becomes the validation row instead of entering a padded card.
transitions.outgoingState: Queued work packet is visible on the source board.
transitions.bridgeAction: Rectangular packet stretches along the grid baseline with flush bounds.
transitions.incomingState: Validated packet lands as the primary rectangle on the target board.
transitions.compositionShift: Left board becomes right board through shared grid baseline.
transitions.colorShift: Hue marks validated state only; grayscale still carries hierarchy.
transitions.cameraShift: No camera move; orthogonal morph holds scale.

validationFrames.passCriterion: All boxes have zero internal padding and use the declared grayscale hierarchy.

validationChecks.passCriterion: Packet, mask, and destination stay square, flush, and grayscale-level consistent.
